name: generate-test-senior-qa
description: Playwright coverage for the Generate KiwiSaver public join form (step 1).

scripts.test: PLAYWRIGHT_HTML_OUTPUT_DIR=playwright-report playwright test --project=chromium --grep-invert @defect; code=$?; [ -n "$CI" ] || playwright show-report playwright-report; exit $code
scripts.test:defects: PLAYWRIGHT_HTML_OUTPUT_DIR=playwright-report-defects playwright test --project=chromium --grep @defect --output=test-results-defects; code=$?; [ -n "$CI" ] || playwright show-report playwright-report-defects; exit $code
